purpose: 原创门槛邀请的明暗组织局部试验，非A05完整风格或成片验收

prompts.V1: Use case: illustration-story. Original production study, a single wide 16:9 cinematic concept frame, no lettering or logos. Setting: a small coastal town community hall at dusk, a textile worker in a brick-red loose coat stands alone just outside an open doorway, dark navy interior with modest amber festival lights and distant silhouettes. Another adult worker wearing a pale work shirt and dark trousers stands inside and extends an open palm toward the outsider, inviting them in; hands have NOT touched yet. Show both adults full or three-quarter bodies, their gaze and open shoulder directions clearly toward each other, a narrow empty threshold between them. Outsider carries a folded rain cape in their other hand; ordinary short dark hair, human faces, no fantasy horns, no jewelry motif, no apples, no dragon, no red dress. Make the emotional action legible without captions: the outsider hesitates while being invited. Use editorial digital painting with decisive simplified light/dark shapes, off-white skin highlights, brick vermilion against deep charcoal/navy, small muted amber accents, selectively sharp focal edges around eyes and inviting hand, rough quiet background, no all-over glossy detail. Important: preserve a large calm dark value region behind the extended pale hand so the gap and invitation read at thumbnail size; restrained light paths tie the two figures together. This is an original independent scene studying value grouping and relationship, not a copy or imitation of any named artist.
prompts.V2: Edit the supplied original image V1 only in its rendering language. Keep exactly the same two adults, identities, facial expressions, poses, gazes, physical spacing, open palm, unjoined hands, coat, cape, doorway geometry, background people, camera and cropping. Do not add fantasy elements or text. The problem in V1 is excessive photographic surface detail, with similar detail density on stones, fabric, water, faces. Translate the entire frame into a deliberate hand-painted digital color rough with flat linked value masses: simplify stone and sea into large quiet planar strokes, coats into broad angular red and charcoal shapes, skin into two or three unblended light planes. Preserve selective hard contour at the inviting hand and both eyes, relax edges in the distant harbor and crowd, suppress most small water highlights and fabric wrinkles. Keep all big illumination and colors as in V1; no new light sources, no composition change, no uniformly black outline. Make the red coat and pale hand read together at thumbnail scale. This is a form-grouping test, not a claim to imitate any artist.
